name: PAMTreatmentStandalone
title: A7 Treatment + Ganzoni — standalone test form
publisher: FHIR in Queensland Health Connectathon — Track 1 (synthetic demo, not for clinical use)
description: Standalone test form for scenario A7: the soln-pam-treatment module plus the input items and root variables it needs.

item.text: Patient details and pathology (copied from modules A1 and A5)
Weight, height, sex and latest Hb are needed for the iron dose: fill them in under Patient details and Pathology.
Total iron dose (Ganzoni) = dosing weight × (target Hb − actual Hb) × 0.24 + iron stores

extension.valueString:
Total iron dose (Ganzoni) = dosing weight (kg) × (target Hb − actual Hb) (g/L) × 0.24 + iron stores (mg)

Dosing weight: ideal body weight (Devine) if the patient weighs more than that, otherwise actual weight. Target Hb 150 g/L and iron stores 500 mg (130 g/L and 15 mg/kg under 35 kg). National Blood Authority, Iron product choice and dose calculation for adults (2016).

valueExpression.expression: iif(%weight.empty(), {}, iif(%idealWeight.exists() and %idealWeight < %weightKg, 'ideal body weight (actual weight is above ideal)', iif(%idealWeight.empty(), 'actual weight (no height for ideal body weight)', 'actual weight (at or below ideal)')))

item.text: Suggested total dose (to the nearest 100 mg)
Prescribe a different total dose from the suggested one
The prescribed dose is above the calculated total iron deficit (rounded to the nearest 100 mg): the cumulative dose should not exceed the deficit (NBA 2016).
More than three infusions: check the dose and plan the extra infusions by hand.

Per-infusion maximum (Australian product information): ferric carboxymaltose 20 mg/kg up to 1000 mg, and no more than 1000 mg a week; ferric derisomaltose 20 mg/kg, single doses above 1500 mg not recommended, split doses at least a week apart. 20 mg/kg uses the dosing weight.
Requested date of the first infusion

extension.valueString: 'Total iron dose ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-dose').answer.value.toString() + ' mg (Ganzoni total iron deficit ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-ganzoni').answer.value.toString() + ' mg: dosing weight ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-dosing-weight').answer.value.toString() + ' kg, Hb ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-tx-hb').answer.value.toString() + ' g/L, target ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-target-hb').answer.value.toString() + ' g/L, iron stores ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-stores').answer.value.toString() + ' mg), in ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-infusions').answer.value.toString() + ' infusion(s) of at most ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-max-infusion').answer.value.toString() + ' mg, at least 7 days apart.'

'Infusion 2 of ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-infusions').answer.value.toString() + ': ' + %resource.repeat(item).where(linkId='pam-iron-dose-2').answer.value.toString() + ' mg IV' + ', at least 7 days after the previous infusion'
